content.title: This Clue From Masked Singer Ozzfest Night All But Confirms Galaxy Girl's Identity (SPOILERS)
content.text: Published Mar 4, 2026, 9:00 PM EST Lorianne Palinkas has been a reality television writer for Screen Rant for four years. After teaching middle school English for twenty years, she knows a thing or two about high drama, complicated alliances, and even singing competitions. Growing up in New York City gave her a solid foundation in the arts and culture. WARNING! THIS ARTICLE CONTAINS MAJOR SPOILERS ABOUT THE MASKED SINGER SEASON 14!The Masked Singer season 14 contestant Galaxy Girl has puzzled the panelists since her debut, but a revealing clue on Ozzfest Night might've just given away her true identity as singer and actress Ashlee Simpson. The Masked Singer season 14 welcomed back host Nick Cannon, as well as panelists Robin Thicke, Jenny McCarthy-Wahlberg, Ken Jeong, and Rita Ora. So far, Galaxy Girl has performed three times, singing "Super Graphic Ultra Modern Girl" by Chappell Roan on Premiere Night, "Just a Girl" by No Doubt on Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Night, and "Drive" by Incubus on Ozzfest Night. Galaxy Girl's Ozzfest Night Clue All But Proves That She's Ashlee Simpson During The Masked Singer season 14 Ozzfest Night, Galaxy Girl shared that her first concert was Lilith Fair, and she remembered seeing the women perform on stage and thinking that she wanted to be them. Ashlee has shared that her first concert was Lilith Fair. Ashlee is the younger sister of music superstar Jessica Simpson. However, she eventually came out of her shadow and launched a music career of her own. Ashlee has played at several music festivals, including Music Midtown (2004), Kiss Concert (2004), Summer Music Mania (2004), and Canyon Sessions (2018). In April 2026, Ashlee is scheduled to perform at Stagecoach Festival. Other Ozzfest Night Clues That Prove Galaxy Girl Is Ashlee Related The Masked Singer's Heidi Montag Reveals Injury She Sustained As Snow Cone That Would've Taken Her Out Of The Competition & Talks About New Music Masked Singer's Heidi Montag reveals an injury she sustained as Snow Cone that would've forced her to leave the competition if she wasn't eliminated. A toy gondola in a fountain was a reference to Ashlee's 2025-2026 "I Am Me" residency at Voltaire at The Venetian Resort Las Vegas, where gondola rides are a popular tourist attraction. In addition, Kelly was able to guess her not only because of what she called the sexy gravel in her voice, but because, at the end of her performance, Galaxy Girl did a jig that was similar to the one that Ashlee did on Saturday Night Live during the infamous incident when she was caught lip-syncing on stage. Galaxy Girl's Premiere & Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Night Clues Also Prove She's Ashlee During The Masked Singer season 14 Premiere Night, Galaxy Girl revealed in her clue package that she was accepted into the best schools on scholarship, and she was the youngest on stage. This matches Ashlee's experience of enrolling in the School of American Ballet in New York City when she was eleven. She was the youngest person ever to be admitted. Several of Ashlee's songs were referenced in her clue packages as well. A "Welcome 2 LA" sign on Premiere Night was a nod to her song "La La," while a calendar page with Friday the 13th circled was a reference to the film Freaky Friday, which featured her song, "Just Let Me Cry," on its soundtrack. On The Masked Singer season 14 Premiere Night, the constellations Virgo and Libra were shown in Galaxy Girl's clue package. Ashlee was born on October 3, which makes her a Libra, while her husband, actor and singer Evan Ross, was born on August 26, and is a Virgo. In addition, a yellow surfboard clue referenced Ashlee's two Teen Choice Awards because the award is a surfboard. A bowl of oranges rejected by Galaxy Girl was a nod to Ashlee's 2005 Orange Bowl halftime show, during which she was booed while singing her single, "La La." This performance followed her disastrous Saturday Night Live appearance, which she referenced on Premiere Night when she said that she wasn't perfect. Although it's only speculation right now, The Masked Singer season 14's Galaxy Girl seems to be Ashlee. Kelly was most likely right with her guess, but fans will probably have to wait a bit longer to find out the truth because Galaxy Girl is such a talented performer. She'll most likely advance to the finals and win the Golden Mask Trophy. The Masked Singer season 14's Galaxy Girl is out-of-this-world.
